description: This file defines a Debug class in the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It contains methods to track execution time before and after specific routes, primarily for debugging purposes.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A controller class used for debugging, tracking execution time of routes within the admin event system.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Records the current microtime in session data for the given route to measure execution duration.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time since the 'before' method was called for a route and logs the route. (Note: The code appears to log only the route name, not the timing data.)
